notes.note: Reviewed the a2569b029e1 policy delta: the shared base CSP admits station-plugin: only, and the Windows platform overlay replaces script/style sources with Wry's exact http://station-plugin.localhost alias. Other platforms and the external Vite header do not admit the HTTP alias as an ordinary loopback host. The production native boundary gate checks both configurations; focused tests cover the real base/Windows bytes and reject widened loopback/blob sources. Existing runtime, release, mobile, icon and integration claims are unchanged by these CSP/import-ratchet edits. Desktop documentation now states the packaged Windows overlay and the remaining Windows Vite development limitation explicitly. This is a bounded source/configuration review; Rust compilation, handler-path mutation catch and real Desktop rendering remain NOT_VERIFIED because the host disk guard refused compilation.
